title: Toys/animal-island
caption: Animal Island
description: A 3D game for toddlers: tap the cow, pig, sheep and friends on a little island to hear their names and noises, shake the trees for apples, or play Where's the pig?
tagline: Tap the animals on a little 3D island to hear their names and noises

title: Toys/bear-beat
caption: Bear Beat
description: Animated bears dance on a light-up disco floor to the beat of whatever they hear: the microphone, a song file, a built-in groove or tapped tempo. Ten routines from the Moonwalk to the Macarena, for one to four bears
tagline: Bears dance on a disco floor to the beat of whatever they hear

title: Toys/blobbles
caption: Blobbles
description: Blobs of glass at your command
tagline: Blobs of glass at your command

title: Toys/bowling-bear
caption: Bowling Bear
description: Ten-pin bowling in 3D with a bear that cheers you on. Up to four play round one phone or tablet, against each other or the computer, as the lane swings round to each bowler. Or play on phones on the same Wi-Fi, with no server: they join by scanning each other's QR codes. Swipe to roll and curve the swipe to hook
tagline: Ten-pin bowling in 3D, with a bear that cheers you on

title: Toys/catflap
caption: Catflap
description: A game for small children: let the cat in through the cat flap, then tap to give it dinner, water, treats and fish until it curls up in its basket to sleep
tagline: Let the cat in, give it its dinner and watch it curl up to sleep

title: Toys/clockwork-marble-flick
caption: Clockwork Marble Flick
description: Blueprints for a wind-up tabletop Marble Flick: a working 3D model of the movement to turn, take apart and wind, six drawing sheets, and the schedules of wheels, speeds and parts
tagline: Blueprints for a wind-up Marble Flick, with a working model of its clockwork

title: Toys/engravery
caption: Engravery
description: Hide a photo in a field of parallel lines, then squint to see it reappear
tagline: Hide a photo in a field of parallel lines, then squint to see it

title: Toys/canon-eos-r10-field-guide
caption: EOS R10 Field Guide
description: An interactive guide to the Canon EOS R10 with the RF-S18-150mm lens: a 3D body to turn over and click on, every control explained, the full menu tree to step through with the arrow keys, the shooting screen's readouts and the changes in firmware 1.7.0
tagline: A clickable 3D camera body and its full menu tree

title: Toys/flowing-field
caption: Flowing Field
description: An animated ink drawing of thousands of fine pen strokes sweeping into dark creased ridges. Drag to rake the strokes into line, then randomise, explore nearby drawings and cycle psychedelic colours
tagline: Thousands of fine pen strokes sweep into ridges and rake into line under your finger

title: Toys/fractaliser
caption: Fractaliser
description: A fast, smooth explorer of the Mandelbrot set and its relatives, the Tricorn, Burning Ship and Cubic Multibrot, and their Julia sets: zoom deep into them, randomise, and browse nearby variations of colour and place
tagline: A fast, smooth explorer of the Mandelbrot set and its relatives

title: Toys/jpegulator
caption: Jpegulator
description: Turn PNG, WebP, TIFF and other images into JPEGs, cropped and resized alike, one at a time or a whole folder into a ZIP
tagline: Turn any image into a JPEG, cropped and resized, one at a time or a whole folder

title: Toys/jumbleword
caption: Jumbleword
description: Four, five, six or seven lettered balls land in the rack: spell every word hidden in them to fill the card, and shout house when one word uses every ball
tagline: Spell every word hidden in a rack of lettered balls

title: Toys/knottery
caption: Knottery
description: Draw Celtic knots freehand: strokes become woven ribbons, and a tap on a crossing flips which strand passes over
tagline: Draw Celtic knots freehand, and tap a crossing to flip it

title: Toys/lala-yala
caption: Lala & Yala
description: Four tap-only games for toddlers starring two grey cats and their friends: hide and seek, bubble popping, guessing silhouettes and counting fish into a bowl
tagline: Four tap-only games for toddlers, starring two grey cats

title: Toys/lozengineer
caption: Lozengineer
description: An op art explorer of lozenge tilings, the flat shadows of stacked cubes, with every rhombus striped along one diagonal so the stripes run on unbroken from tile to tile, curling into hooks and forking at the corners. Tap the pattern to turn a hexagon of tiles, tweak the sliders, randomise, explore variations and save SVG or PNG
tagline: Striped rhombus tilings whose lines hook, fork and spiral from tile to tile

title: Toys/marble-flick
caption: Marble Flick
description: Flick marbles into the rings and knock your rivals into the hole, watched over by some very opinionated cats. For up to four players and computer opponents around one screen
tagline: Flick marbles into the rings, watched by some very opinionated cats

title: Toys/marblelous
caption: Marblelous
description: Drop inks onto a virtual marbling bath and comb them into swirling Florentine patterns
tagline: Drop inks onto a marbling bath and comb them into Florentine swirls

title: Toys/meadow-games
caption: Meadow Games
description: Five tap-only 3D games for toddlers with a herd of cows, horses, foxes and friends: peekaboo, all fall down, bedtime in the barn, find the same and pairs
tagline: Five tap-only 3D games for toddlers in a meadow full of animals

title: Toys/mimic
caption: Mimic
description: Feed in any text and dial up the gibberish index to generate new phrases in the same style
tagline: Feed in any text and generate new phrases in the same style

title: Toys/over-underiser
caption: Over-Underiser
description: Open an SVG and weave it: wherever closed shapes overlap, a click cycles which one passes over the top
tagline: Weave any SVG: click an overlap to choose which shape goes on top

title: Toys/plong
caption: Plong
description: Pong for everyone at once: each player guards one side of a polygon arena, on one tablet or with phones joining a projector over the same Wi-Fi by QR code. Lose your lives and you haunt the others as a ghost, and a toddler's phone can shrink, wobble or splat anyone
tagline: Pong for everyone at once, round a polygon, with phones as paddles

title: Toys/quizbuzz
caption: Quizbuzz
description: A family quiz show for Christmas: a 1960s TV studio on the big screen, a buzzer on everyone's phone, joined by QR code over the same Wi-Fi, and a toddler button with real power
tagline: A family quiz show: a 1960s TV studio on the big screen and a buzzer on every phone

title: Toys/radialator
caption: Radialator
description: An op art explorer of radial parity patterns: rings of overlapping shapes, coloured black or white by how many of them cover each point, crossed with spokes and rings, or laid as ribbons of coloured stone like a Cosmati pavement. Tweak the sliders, randomise, explore nearby patterns and download them as SVG
tagline: Rings of overlapping shapes flip black and white into dizzying op art rosettes

title: Toys/rug-addict
caption: Rug Addict
description: Persian, Anatolian, Caucasian and Turkmen rugs generated knot by knot from the grammar of real carpets: borders, field, medallions and motifs, shown as wool pile, as a weaver's cartoon or on the floor of a room, with randomise and eight-way exploration
tagline: Persian and Anatolian rugs, generated knot by knot from the grammar of real carpets

title: Toys/spotty-sphericle
caption: Spotty Sphericle
description: Thousands of dots on a spinning sphere, cube, doughnut, water drop or cloud, sized by the light falling on them: flick it, move the light, and breed new variations
tagline: Thousands of dots on a spinning sphere, sized by the light falling on them

title: Toys/sunthesis
caption: Sunthesis
description: Photorealistic sunsets computed from the physics of sunlight passing through air, haze, cloud and water: start from one of 43 real photographs, then randomise, explore nearby skies and export HDR pictures
tagline: Photorealistic sunsets computed from the physics of light in air, haze and cloud

title: Toys/lenticulator
caption: The Lenticulator
description: Print and fold lenticular pictures that change as the observer moves
tagline: Print and fold pictures that change as you move past them

title: Toys/trackaholic
caption: Trackaholic
description: A car race through a glowing valley at dusk, against bots on one screen or with phones joining over the same Wi-Fi by QR code. Every track is new, and the car has real suspension and tyre grip, so brake before the bends
tagline: A car race through a glowing valley at dusk, against bots or everyone's phones

title: Toys/trundle-world
caption: Trundle World
description: A little 3D island for small children to poke at: cars and a steam train trundle round, a volcano erupts, dinosaurs graze, parachutists drop from aeroplanes, and everything reacts when tapped, by day or night, in four sizes of town
tagline: A little 3D island for small children to poke at

title: Toys/tunerful
caption: Tunerful
description: A guitar tuner built like a chart recorder: it listens through the microphone, spots the string you play, and plots its pitch on paper that scrolls up from the pen, with reference tones for eight tunings
tagline: A guitar tuner built like a chart recorder

title: Toys/vectorious
caption: Vectorious
description: Quantise a photo to black and white and trace it into a vector drawing, downloadable as SVG or PDF
tagline: Trace a photo into a crisp vector drawing, ready to download as SVG or PDF
